market.summary: Vietnam has substantial national, provincial/city public and university collections, with local commercial platforms alongside Koha and international systems. The observed catalog sample is heterogeneous and is not a market-share estimate. National/provincial administrative mergers require present institution identity to be separated from legacy catalog scope.
market.platform_strategy: Start a bounded UCVN national-library integration and reusable KIPOS and Vebrary adapter work, each latter family supported by two distinct successful deployments. Retain Koha reuse as a conditional reserve until HUAF test-labelled holdings are resolved. Public-network HCMC and Sierra/VNUHCM offer broad leverage but current access checks block automation. PSC zLIS offers an observed anonymous JSON search; SLIB and custom portals need separate adapters.

adoption_evidence.claim: Vendor describes Libol and lists major public/university customers. Undated/historical client list is adoption evidence, not current deployments or national share.
CMC describes iLib8 for public, university and specialist libraries, with Vietnamese processing. Product presence, not a market-share census.
D&L claims more than 30 Koha clients across Vietnam AND Southeast Asia; this does not establish 30 Vietnam installations.
Two independently verified KIPOS public searches:DHHP andNTU; two Vebrary searches:LRC andHUSC.
